description: This PHP script defines the Upgrade11 class within the Opencart installation upgrade process. It performs database schema updates, data migrations, and cleanup tasks during a version upgrade, including updating serialized data, merging affiliate data into customers, and removing obsolete fields and tables.

classes.name: Upgrade11
classes.description: A class that manages the upgrade process to version 11 in the Opencart installation, handling database updates, data migration, and cleanup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade steps, including data updates, schema modifications, and cleanup operations.
